pt.title: Contas a pagar a partir do e-mail
pt.body: Lê boletos e faturas nas caixas de e-mail em modo somente leitura, extrai emissor, valor e vencimento, lança na planilha e cria lembretes 3 dias antes e no dia. Nunca paga nada sozinha.

en.title: Bills payable from email
en.impact: Bills never slip past their due date.
en.body: Reads bills and invoices from mailboxes in read-only mode, extracts issuer, amount and due date, logs them in the spreadsheet and sets reminders 3 days before and on the day. It never pays anything on its own.
